Implemented and locally verified the complete Artifactory website: **23 units, 34 English/Polish routes, and all five checkpoints**.

The preview is running at `http://127.0.0.1:4321/en/` and is queued to open in the app. Polish starts at `http://127.0.0.1:4321/pl/`.

Verification completed:

- 51 Chromium checks, four component-fixture checks, and 15 unit tests pass.
- Firefox and WebKit pass the demo-to-local-receipt journey.
- All 136 final axe reports contain zero violations.
- All six cold-mobile Lighthouse samples score **100**, with median LCP around **1.20 seconds** and **zero layout shift**.
- Redirects, localized 404s, publication gates, failed-build isolation and source/artifact recovery pass.
- All 113 protected package files remain unchanged.

[Run instructions and maintenance guide](/Users/michal.lukasiewicz/Programming/website-development-experiment/runs/2026-10-09-pair-01/01-detailed/website/README.md) · [Acceptance report and evidence](/Users/michal.lukasiewicz/Programming/website-development-experiment/runs/2026-10-09-pair-01/01-detailed/website/docs/acceptance-report.md) · [Execution and repair history](/Users/michal.lukasiewicz/Programming/website-development-experiment/runs/2026-10-09-pair-01/01-detailed/website/docs/execution-record.md)

Synthetic local delivery is verified; the Resend adapter has isolated protocol tests. **Real email delivery remains unverified, human content/language/asset reviews remain pending, and nothing has been published.**

Running at `http://127.0.0.1:4317/en/` — verified it responds successfully.

The preview is queued to open in Codex, and the server is staying running.

It’s written in **vanilla JavaScript, HTML and CSS**, using **Node.js** to generate the static pages and run the local server.

Browser JavaScript handles menus, language switching and enquiry drafts. Tests use Node’s test runner, Playwright and axe for accessibility checks.

The website’s content is in **English and Polish**.

Implemented the Artifactory website in the assigned repository, with **17 pages in English and Polish—34 routes total**.

It includes responsive layouts, original labeled technical illustrations, detailed ArtiSense and AIFIELD pages, investor and partnership journeys, equivalent-page language switching, mobile navigation, legacy redirects and localized 404s.

Start it with:

```sh
cd /Users/michal.lukasiewicz/Programming/website-development-experiment/runs/2026-10-09-pair-01/02-inputs-only/website
npm ci
npm run dev
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:4317/en/`. The temporary verification server has been stopped.

**Verified:** successful build, all 7 structural tests and all 9 browser tests. Checks cover every route, both languages at 320px width, mobile menus, contact validation and clipboard fallback, metadata, redirects, reduced motion and no-JavaScript behavior. Representative templates pass automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks. Desktop and mobile screenshots were inspected.

**Contact limitation:** the form prepares a copyable email draft; it does not deliver enquiries. No receiving service or verified mailbox access was supplied, so the site never claims successful delivery.

Nothing was published. Remaining release dependencies are factual and translation approval, approved identity/evidence assets, a verified receiver with privacy arrangements, and hosting authorization. Safari, Firefox and actual email receipt remain unverified.

The [website README](/Users/michal.lukasiewicz/Programming/website-development-experiment/runs/2026-10-09-pair-01/02-inputs-only/website/README.md) documents commands, architecture, content provenance and the specific blockers.
